question: Under fixed physiology and exact basal G/I and SC input, what do dynamic G, G+I and G+I+C-peptide constrain about evoked responsivity, peripheral insulin removal and central C-peptide removal?
parent_protocol: BC-008/2 fixed hepatic route; BC-010/1 C-peptide equations and nominal parameters

model.conditioning: Exact nominal basal plasma G and I and constant SC input in every modality; all non-varied parameters and meal known. Gain scales beta and K together, never basal secretion or cell number.
model.initialization: From BC008 nominal basal: keep Ip, SC depots and other native states; Il=((m2+m4)*Ip-Rsc)/m1, Sb=(m1+m30)*Il-m2*Ip, Z=Sb, P=Sb/gamma; Cp Q1=Sb/k3, Q2=k1*Q1/k2. Rsc=ka1*Isc1+ka2*Isc2. Sb is derived, not independently fitted.
model.boundary: Append passive Q1,Q2,removed,delivered Cp states to BC008 RHS. Drive by Spo, equimolar pmol/(kg min), without hepatic removal, SC input or portal transit. Integrate in the native lock; check against independent matrix exponential and historical equations.

observation.noise: Independent additive Gaussian engineering noise, not estimated assay error; same 1-min realization shared across modalities and nested schedules. Basal G/I are exact conditioning values (noise zero at t0); Cp t0 remains observed/noisy. No clipping negative noisy observations.

inference.known_kinetics: fit gain only; m4,k3 fixed at truth
inference.unknown_clearance: declare gain,m4,k3 unknown; G/GI optimize gain,m4 only and label k3 unobservable, never an estimate; GIC optimizes all three
inference.objective: sum(((prediction-observation)/channel_SD)^2); optimize natural-log parameters with frozen bounds; store every start and residual
inference.noisy_reporting: per-seed estimates, truth error, bound hits, start disagreement and objective; two draws are diagnostics, not uncertainty coverage or success rates
inference.scope: finite-difference local rank and bounded multistart recovery; no profile likelihood, global uniqueness proof, confidence intervals or human identifiability

verification: Reference/fit/independent solvers at truth and both bound corners; fasting derivative at each; nominal comparison with BC008 integrate; Cp matrix-exponential response using source sampling refinement; insulin and Cp mass balances; gain versus beta/K exact symmetry and passive unobservable k3; finite-difference/solver Jacobian refinement; fresh-process repetition of full matrix.
failure_policy: Archive each dataset and both starts including optimizer failure. Model/incomplete/nonfinite failure is retained and invalidates that attempt, never replaced with a fabricated residual. A missing matrix, numerical gate or observable noiseless recovery failure makes experiment incomplete/failed. Noisy recovery failure, bound hits and unobservable parameters are findings, not discarded cases.

protocol_history.amendment_before_numerical_fitting: Replace relative scipy log-coordinate differences (degenerate near log(1)=0) with fixed absolute log steps and bounded one-sided three-point differences. Clarify SD-squared weighting and hepatic-clearance exclusion. No numerical results inspected; bounds, noise, matrix and acceptance criteria unchanged.
